sites.name: Nga Bay Floating Market (Phung Hiep Floating Market)
sites.event: One of the oldest and busiest floating markets in the Mekong Delta, immortalized in poetry with the Vong Co song 'Tinh anh ban chieu'.

sites.name: Lung Ngoc Hoang Nature Reserve
sites.event: Known as the 'green lung' of the Mekong Delta, a place that preserves the biodiversity of the pristine wetlands.

sites.name: Tam Vu Victory Historical Site
sites.event: Marking 4 glorious battles in the early years of the resistance against the French, famous for the capture of the 105mm cannon (Ong Ho).

sites.name: Xa No Canal
sites.event: Known as the 'Rice Road' of the Mekong Delta, the largest irrigation project in Cochinchina during the French colonial period (dug in 1901).

sites.name: Uncle Ho's Temple
sites.event: Built by local people to worship Uncle Ho right in the enemy's rear area upon hearing of his passing (in 1969).

sites.name: Tu Sang Bamboo Garden (Bamboo Garden)
sites.event: A unique bamboo garden with thousands of intertwined bamboo trees, creating a peaceful countryside scene rich in Southern identity.

sites.name: Cau Duc Pineapple Field
sites.event: A famous specialized pineapple cultivation area, the 'Cau Duc Pineapple' brand dates back to the French colonial period.

sites.name: Can Tho Provincial Party Committee Base (Ba Bai Base)
sites.event: A resilient revolutionary base of the Party Committee, soldiers, and people of Can Tho (former) during the resistance war against the US (1972-1975).

sites.name: Truc Lam Hau Giang Zen Monastery
sites.event: A major spiritual and cultural work, a Buddhist architectural highlight of the Truc Lam Yen Tu Zen sect in Hau Giang.

sites.name: Tay Do Eco-tourism Area
sites.event: A large amusement, entertainment, and orchard eco-tourism destination, suitable for picnic activities.

sites.name: Historical Site of the Victory over 75 Enemy Battalions
sites.event: Marking the resounding victory of the military and people of Military Zone 9 in defeating 75 enemy battalions and the 21st Division of the puppet regime (in 1973).
